turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response: Well, my regular doctor told me I needed to come see you. He says I've gotten too thin. I mean, I can see that my work pants are hanging pretty loose on me lately, but... to be honest, part of me still feels relieved when the number on the scale is lower. So, he wanted me to talk to someone about it.

turns.doctor_question: Are you afraid of gaining weight?
turns.patient_response: Yes, I am. I mean, if I eat something a bit heavier, like biscuits or pasta, I... I spend the rest of the day just scared that it's going to show on me. I end up keeping on checking myself, just thinking about how I need to make up for it somehow.

turns.doctor_question: Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time, feeling like you can't stop?

turns.doctor_question: Do you do anything to try to prevent weight gain after eating?

turns.doctor_question: Do you think your weight is a problem even when others say you are too thin?

So, what other people say doesn't really change how I see it.
